notes: Partition verified: all 16 source ids and all 24 target ids occur exactly once across the 16 units.

The added *but* (t016) is correct and is the deciding call of the verse: the clause דַּרְכָּם בְּרֹאשָׁם נָתָתִּי contains no waw and no other conjunction, so no morpheme licenses the connective, and rule 51's second half forbids folding it into the neighbouring verb.

s003 takes the whole *as for me*, which realizes the fronted independent pronoun and nothing else, headed on *me* under rule 24; גַּם keeps its own postposed *also*, so no waw is called on to carry it.
s004 keeps only *not* while s005 takes *shall spare*: the ASV writes negation and modal as two words, which rule 35 splits rather than treating as an indivisible *cannot*.

s008+s009 → *neither* is rule 35's fusion headed on the negative, not rule 14's correlative pair, since no answering *nor* is written. The reverse-ordered MACULA glosses on s014/s015 are a display defect under rule 39 and were read off the morphology.
